verdict.rationale: Microsoft's privacy FAQ documents an opt-out from using your conversation activity for model training, available at any time. It also documents deleting individual conversations or your full history, which partly covers controlling usage data. The evidence never mentions a general telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so only the training-data slice of the story is shown. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/diagnostic-data opt-out, an opt-out for usage analytics or tracking, coverage across Office-integrated Copilot surfaces, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out works.
